alternate_reference_check.method: Independent symmetric matrix M^(-1/2) A M^(-1/2), transformed scalar affine forcing, then M^(-1/2) Q reconstruction; production script is not imported.
alternate_reference_check.special_function_evaluation: mp.exp(x*x)*mp.erfc(x) below x=1e6; 30-term erfcx asymptotic expansion above x=1e6.
alternate_reference_check.selection: First node, middle-index node, terminal node and maximum nodal-error node in each of the eight m=512 trajectories.

limitations: This script reads saved trajectories and performs no differential-equation solver run.
Full-history residuals are independently recomputed at 64 selected time nodes; saved residual normalizations are checked at every node of all 48 trajectories.
Alternative 120-digit reference checks cover 32 selected nodes, not every point or an interval enclosure.
Floating-point differences, residuals and sampled PL errors are numerical diagnostics, not certified bounds.
Selected finite masses do not prove mass-uniformity or an asymptotic convergence rate.
